title: Welcome to Xpert Mind
excerpt: How this blog works — write in the dashboard, insert images and icons mid-article, then publish.
content:
Start here

Xpert Mind is your writing space. Use the dashboard to draft posts, then publish them to the public blog.

Between paragraphs you can drop an icon or an image to break up the reading rhythm and highlight a point.

What you can do

  • Write long-form posts with headings and lists
  • Upload images into the middle of an article
  • Insert icons as visual markers
  • Save drafts or publish immediately

Open the dashboard, sign in, and create your next post.
